links.outcome: Readability of LLM breast cancer answers for patients
links.effect: Issues like poor readability remain in answers; Doubao-2.2-thinking had significantly lower reading difficulty, required age, and Chinese character count (adjusted P < 0.05).
links.quote: However, issues like poor readability and unsafe recommendations remain in answers.

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and safety of LLM breast cancer answers
links.effect: No significant accuracy difference among models; ChatGPT-5.4-thinking scored significantly lower in safety; unsafe recommendations remain in answers.
links.quote: ChatGPT-5.4-thinking scored significantly lower in safety, and Doubao-2.2-thinking had significantly lower reading difficulty, required age, and Chinese character count (adjusted P < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, accuracy, readability, and safety of six commercial large language models for breast cancer patient education using expert ratings and small patient evaluation groups, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
